text:
Ethan (Partnerships): heads up 3: GlacierCompute's EU procurement just rejected the marketplace PO for their rack order. They flagged VAT/EORI mismatch and hung on shipping docs.
Priya (Deal Desk): which error code from the portal?
vendor-bot: marketplace-api: PO validation failed -> code 409_vat_mismatch / missing_eori
Marco (Marketplace): yep that's the 409 flow. Portal expects billing_entity VAT ID to match the vendor-approved tax id list exactly.
Ethan (Partnerships): PO GC-2024-778 submitted with billing entity "Redwood Inference Inc." and VAT ID "GB999 888 77" but Glacier's buyer says they need invoices from the EU-registered subsidiary (Redwood EU SARL) with EORI FR12XXXXXXX for customs.
Rita (Finance): We do have an EU entity but it's not onboarded in the marketplace vendor profile. Adding an entity triggers tax onboarding and might create duplicate ledger paths. ETA 2 business days.
Priya (Deal Desk): Glacier insists shipments can't clear customs without EORI match. They won't accept shipments held at port. Any quick workaround? Manual invoice + letter of credit?
Jae (Legal): Manual invoice could work but Glacier's procurement pointed to a marketplace clause that requires all orders to flow through the vendor portal for audit. Deviating may breach their audit control.
Marco (Marketplace): Operationally, we could map the PO to the EU entity in the portal if Finance provides the EU entity tax docs and EORI. I can do an emergency patch to the vendor record to accept PO GC-2024-778 once docs are uploaded.
Ethan (Partnerships): Glacier buyer proposes two options: (A) we add Redwood EU SARL as the billing entity for this PO and confirm EORI on file, or (B) Glacier will accept a customs broker letter if we supply a stamped EORI attestation within 24 hours.
Rita (Finance): Option A requires EU onboarding paperwork + VAT reg cert + legalized EORI proof. We can expedite and get a provisional cert uploaded within 8 hours if legal signs the attestation.
Jae (Legal): I can draft a one-page attestation that links our global VAT registration to Redwood EU SARL and confirms EORI FR12XXXXXXX. But procurement insists on signature with company stamp. Do we have that capability this week?
Priya (Deal Desk): Also note: the PO in the portal references our master services schedule (MSA) signed under "Redwood Inference, Inc." Changing billing entity could trigger MSA mismatch on their system. We need Glacier procurement to accept an addendum or a signed one-liner accepting the EU entity for hardware POs.
Ethan (Partnerships): I'll push the one-liner request to the Glacier buyer now.
Marco (Marketplace): Heads-up: making the vendor record accept multiple entities will alter validation rules. We'll need to version the schema so POs still validate historical POs. Quick change possible but I need explicit files: VAT cert PDF + EORI PDF + signed attestation email.
Rita (Finance): I've started FIN ticket FIN-8420 and uploaded initial VAT cert. ETA for notarized EORI doc: 6 hours.
Jae (Legal): Draft attestation posted to drive link in thread. Can someone from Partnerships request Glacier procurement to accept the attestation + include this sentence in their email: "GlacierProcurement accepts invoices issued to 'Redwood EU SARL (EORI: FR12XXXXXXX)' for PO GC-2024-778 and waives MSA billing-entity string match for hardware shipments."
Ethan (Partnerships): Sent to buyer, copied Priya. Also asked for scanned company stamp or procurement approval email.
vendor-bot: marketplace-api: pending admin action -> awaiting docs FIN-8420
Priya (Deal Desk): If Glacier won't provide that one-liner, escalate to vendor terms team. But first let's try to get the attestation + EORI scanned.
Marco (Marketplace): When docs land, I can toggle the vendor record to accept Redwood EU SARL and re-run PO ingestion. I will mark a short outage window to test validation.
Rita (Finance): Uploaded notarized EORI PDF to FIN-8420 2 hours later.
Ethan (Partnerships): Glacier buyer replied; they included the exact acceptance sentence and attached their procurement stamp. Forwarding in thread.
Jae (Legal): Acceptance wording looks good. I'll prepare a short addendum referencing PO GC-2024-778 and sign it electronically.
Marco (Marketplace): Applying vendor record change now. Re-running ingestion...
vendor-bot: marketplace-api: PO ingestion re-run -> success. GC-2024-778 accepted. Customs clearance allowed.
Ethan (Partnerships): Shipping cleared. Glacier says they'd prefer this workflow codified in the marketplace onboarding checklist.
Priya (Deal Desk): Agreed 1: add checklist item "EU entity + EORI verified for hardware shipments" and escalate if missing.
Rita (Finance): Note for downstream: create ledger mapping for Redwood EU SARL to avoid manual reconciliation. FIN-8420 updated.
Marco (Marketplace): I'll add a schema flag to vendor records to accept per-PO entity overrides and update validation docs.
Jae (Legal): I'll draft a short playbook for entity-swaps and attach the attestation template.
Ethan (Partnerships): Great cross-team response. Closing thread after playbook items are in place. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
